Issue: Customer contacted support via email reporting an unexpected PayPal negative balance charge on a day they claim they did not use the service.
Solution: Looked up the user account in VOI Fleet Management using the requester email, which returned 404 ErrUserNotFound. The email address contacting support is not registered in our system. Sent the verification macro requesting the customer to provide their registered Voi account email, Apple ID User ID, or at least two identity verification details (such as full name, mobile number, country of registration, or last 4 digits of the payment card) so we can locate the correct account and investigate the charge.

Hi Francis,

Thank you for reaching out! To assist you, we need to verify your account. However, the email address you're contacting us from isn't currently linked to a Voi account.

To proceed and assist you with your request, please provide:

The email address linked to your Voi account (needed for access)
Or
If you use Apple ID to log in to Voi, please open the app and send us your User ID. You can find it under Profile > Account > User ID.
Any two of the following details for identity verification:
• The full name on your account
• Your User ID (visible in your Profile in the app)
• The mobile number linked to your Voi account
• The country where your Voi account was registered
• The date of your last Voi ride or transaction
• The number of available credits (check Wallet in the app)
• The last four digits of the credit/debit card linked to your Voi account (check Wallet in the app)

If you take a screenshot of your Profile in the app (Profile > Account), this should contain your full name, email address, and user ID, which would be enough for us to verify your account.
 
Once we receive your registered email address and two verification details, we’ll be able to assist you further.
 
For faster support, you can also contact us via the Voi app by clicking Help > Chat with us.
 
Best,


Mina Samir,
